players.bio: Ahmed Ihab Ahmed, known as Ahmed Qasem (Arabic: أحمد قاسم, romanized: ʾAḥmad Qāsim pronounced ; born 12 July 2003), is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Iraq national team.

Alex Muyl (born September 30, 1995) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC. Early career Muyl was raised by French immigrant parents in Manhattan, New York and attended Bard High School Early College on the Lower East Side. Muyl played in the New York Red Bulls Academy system and later trained with the U.S.
Andy Ariel Najar Rodríguez (born 16 March 1993) is a Honduran professional footballer who plays as a right-back for MLS club Nashville SC and the Honduras national team.
Brian Joseph Callaghan II (born July 1, 1981) is an American professional soccer coach who is currently serving as the head coach of Nashville SC.

Brian Oliver Schwake (born August 24, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC. He formerly played for Scottish Premiership side Livingston, and had loan spells at Edinburgh City and Greenock Morton before signing for Spanish side Castellón in 2023.

Bryan Josué Acosta Ramos (born 24 November 1993) is a Honduran professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC and the Honduras national team. Club career Born in La Ceiba, Honduras, Acosta started his professional career with Real C.D. España. He made his debut on 23 September 2013 in a 1–1 draw with C.D.S. Vida.
Cristian Omar Espinoza (born 3 April 1995) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC.

Daniel Harry Lovitz (born August 27, 1991) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC. On February 28, 2017 Daniel Lovitz signed with the Montreal Impact . He made his debut for the United States national team on 27 January 2019 in a friendly against Panama, as a starter.
Edvard Sandvik Tagseth (born 23 January 2001) is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a midfielder for Nashville SC.

Elias Saad (Arabic: إِلْيَاس سَعْد; born 27 December 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a left winger for 2. Bundesliga club Hannover 96 on loan from FC Augsburg. Born in Germany, he plays for the Tunisia national team, having previously been a former international for the Germany national futsal team.
Hany Abubakr Mukhtar (born 21 March 1995) is a German professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Nashville SC in Major League Soccer.
Isaiah LeFlore (born 11 December 2002) is an American professional soccer player who currently plays as a defender (left-back) for Nashville SC in Major League Soccer (MLS).

Jack Maher (born October 28, 1999) is an American professional soccer player who plays for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC. Career Early career Maher played on an amateur contract with United Soccer League side Saint Louis FC during their 2017 season. He committed to play at Indiana University the following year.
Jeison Andrés Palacios Murillo (born 20 March 1994) is a Colombian footballer who plays as a centre-back for Nashville SC.

Joseph Willis (born August 10, 1988) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC. Willis was selected by D.C. United with the 50th pick in the 2011 MLS SuperDraft. He signed a contract with the team on March 16, 2011. Willis served as the backup goalie with Bill Hamid being the first choice goalie.

Jordan Knight is a Canadian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Nashville SC in Major League Soccer (MLS). Born on 13 June 2002 in Mississauga, Ontario, the 23-year-old left-footed defender stands 6' 3" tall.

Joshua Bauer (born July 22, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC. Career Youth, college & amateur Bauer played youth soccer with GPS New Hampshire Classics Elite, helping them to a pair of state titles in 2014 and 2015. He then went on to play college soccer at the University of New Hampshire between 2017 and 2019.
Julian Gaines (born November 5, 2002) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a right-back for MLS Next Pro club Huntsville City FC.

Malachi Molina is a 19-year-old professional soccer defender currently playing for Nashville SC on loan from FC Dallas. A versatile right-back who has also played as an inverted wing-back and forward, he is a product of the FC Dallas Academy.
Matthew Corcoran (born February 17, 2006) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Nashville
Maxwell Woledzi (born 2 July 2001) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC.
Patrick Yazbek (born 5 April 2002) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC and the Australia national team.
Reed Baker-Whiting (born March 31, 2005) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a right-back, left-back, or midfielder for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC.

Samuel William Surridge (born 28 July 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for MLS club Nashville SC. During his time at AFC Bournemouth, he spent time on loan at Weymouth, Poole Town, Yeovil Town, with whom he made his Football League debut, Oldham Athletic and Swansea City.
Abdul Shakur "Shak" Mohammed is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a forward and midfielder for Nashville SC in Major League Soccer (MLS).
Thomas Ivory Williams III (born August 15, 2004) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC.
Warren Steven Madrigal Molina (born 24 July 2004) is a Costa Rican professional footballer who currently plays as a forward for Saprissa and the Costa Rica national team.

Woobens Pacius is a professional footballer who currently plays as a forward for Nashville SC in Major League Soccer (MLS). Born on May 11, 2001, in Terrebonne, Quebec, he represents the Haiti national team internationally.

Xavier William Valdez Derrig (born 23 November 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC. Born in the United States, he represents the Dominican Republic national team.
